verdict.rationale: The Registrar API documents searching and availability checking, and new domains can be registered from the dashboard across 400+ TLDs. Upfront pricing with no hidden fees supports 'honest' only in a pricing sense. Missing for 10: evidence that availability results are instant or fast, alternate TLD suggestions in search results, an explicit policy or independent corroboration against front-running searched names, and hands-on reports of the search experience.
